name: eMACS J1157.9-1046 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J1157.9-1046, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj115791046-hubble
story: Glowing brightly in X-rays, this crowd of galaxies is extremely disturbed, far from settled. Its gravity is strong enough to bend the light of more distant galaxies into multiple images.

claims.text: eMACS J1157.9-1046 is a cluster of galaxies targeted by the eMACS snapshot survey of extremely massive clusters
eMACS clusters are highly X-ray luminous galaxy clusters, and eMACS J1157.9-1046 is one of them
Its gravity produces multiple images of background galaxies (strong lensing)
